Bill.BriefDescription: Developing regional compacts for siting transmission lines.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to developing regional compacts for sitingtransmission lines; adding new sections to chapter 80.50 RCW; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It is the intent of the legislature tocreate a regional process for siting of new transmission lines thatcross state borders in order to encourage neighboring states to actregionally when proposing new transmission projects. This regionalprocess will facilitate the siting of new cross borders electricaltransmission lines by providing a "one stop" licensing process. Thisact calls for the creation of an interstate body to govern theagreement and activities between the states.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 80.50 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A multistate council must be established by compact and be made upof at least three adjoining states, including Washington. Themultistate council must coordinate and oversee the process of siting p. 1 HB 2401transmission lines that cross state borders as permitted by thenational energy policy act of 2005.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 80.50 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The multistate electrical transmission siting council may review,certify, and permit siting of transmission facilities, includingfacilities in national interest electric transmission corridors thatare not on property owned by the United States.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 80.50 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The multistate electrical transmission siting council will:Specify the conditions of construction and operation; issue permits inlieu of any other individual state or local agency authority; andmanage the environmental and safety oversight programs of transmissionline operations.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 80.50 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The multistate electrical transmission siting council consists ofa chair and councilmembers. The chair must be nominated by thecouncilmembers from amongst their membership, and be approved by thegovernors of each participating state. Councilmembers must berepresentatives from the following state agencies or their equivalentfrom each participating state: The department of ecology; thedepartment of fish and wildlife; the department of natural resources;the department of community, trade, and economic development; and theutilities and transportation commission.
